name: @dealsonar/desktop-electron
description: DealSonar Electron desktop shell (candidate): window, tray, dialogs, notifications, autostart, backend utilityProcess supervision.
author: DealSonar <support@dealsonar.invalid>

scripts.pack:dir: pnpm build && pnpm stage && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:mac-arm64: pnpm build && pnpm stage && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:mac-x64: pnpm build && pnpm stage && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:win-x64: pnpm build && pnpm stage && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:linux-x64: pnpm build && pnpm stage && electron-builder --linux deb AppImage --x64 --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
